about: Facts in the study content checked against official AWS pages. checks=2: confirmed by a second checker with a verbatim quote; checks=1: confirmed by one checker against the topic pages listed. result: confirmed | fixed | indirect (only indirect official support). Covers sentences with concrete values (numbers, limits, dates, names, plan features) and the answer keys that blind solvers flagged; all other statements (concepts, comparisons, service-to-use-case mappings) were screened by four reviewers in full and only the flagged or uncertain ones were verified online (entries concept:…). deny = outdated values that must not come back (checked by tests/facts.test.js). watch = exact terms that must stay on the first source page (used when the quote summarizes a list); scripts/facts-watch.js checks quotes and watch terms weekly.
